purpose: Independent read-only review of reviews/CLASSSEP-calibration-adjudication.json (r3-life06, decision c) at the frozen hashes: re-derive the four-arm census with a worker-098 harness instead of the audit harness, test the adoption bar, run a fifth uncited arm (W098 v3), and check the no-write / no-gate-pass claims. Sets no gate verdict and writes no canonical file.

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: every cited path exists and its sha256 matches the adjudication's detectors / frozen_map_snapshot block and the outbox artifact events
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: any cited hash differs from the bytes on disk

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: corpus A (worker-07, 27 fixtures): all four cited arms PASS 17/0/10/0
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: any arm has fn>0 or fp>0

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: corpus C (16 labeled assertion/mention fixtures): APPLIED 4/6 sens 3/10 spec; PRE 4/6, 1/10; STAGED 5/6, 1/10; PROSEFIX 4/6, 10/10
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: any per-arm tp/fn/fp/tn differs from the adjudication

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: corpus D (worker-049, 39 fixtures incl. 12 adversarial/twin pairs): APPLIED 30/1/6/2 with exactly 1 HIGH cue-induced FN (A04); PRE 31/0/6/2; STAGED 31/0/6/2; PROSEFIX 20/11/2/6 with 10 HIGH cue-induced FN
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: any aggregate class count or the HIGH cue-FN arm differs

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: corpus E (worker-035, 23 controls): APPLIED 13/23, PRE 11/23, STAGED 11/23, PROSEFIX 23/23
corpus B on the FROZEN snapshot f344ed2aaea5: APPLIED hard 19 (17 labeled FP + 2 unlabeled claims[327],[336]); PRE 24; STAGED 25; PROSEFIX 1
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: any hard total differs or the unlabeled indices are not 327/336

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: no cited arm meets the declared adoption bar; decision (c) follows from the measured census alone
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: some arm meets all five bar clauses

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: the fifth (uncited) arm W098 v3 6f1a24c441fb also fails the bar: expected corpus A PASS, corpus C 6/6-10/10 or close, corpus D ~31/0/6/2, frozen-snapshot hard 1 at claims[327] (live_metalinguistic=0 fails), so decision (c) is robust to expanding the candidate pool
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: v3 meets all five bar clauses (this would defeat decision c)

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: no canonical/proposed/schema file was written by the adjudication: detector a8c04fc3, PRE c266dbec, STAGED e2d24b92 unchanged; FROZEN.json pins unchanged
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: any canonical hash differs from the cited/review-start bytes

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: the adjudication sets no gate verdict and no validation_status; G-AUDIT is still pending in the live map at review time
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: the adjudication carries a gate verdict or the map shows G-AUDIT != pending

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: the FN attribution correction is right: the 10-HIGH cue-FN belongs to PROSEFIX dc8aa0de3869, not to STAGED e2d24b92 (0 cue-FN)
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: STAGED shows >=1 HIGH cue-induced FN or PROSEFIX shows <10

expectations_written_before_measurement.claim: the live map is a moving surface: at review time it is a different hash/more claims than the frozen snapshot, so every live count is snapshot-bound
expectations_written_before_measurement.falsified_if: the live map equals f344ed2aaea5 at review close (then the growth addendum is stale, not wrong)

falsifier_of_this_review: Any cited hash not matching on disk; any per-arm census differing materially from the adjudication; or W098 v3 meeting all five adoption-bar clauses (which would defeat decision c).
